top_signals.title: Jensen Huang’s Return, Nvidia ETFs Surge
top_signals.summary: "Bloomberg ETF IQ" focuses on the opportunities, risks and current trends tied to the trillions of dollars in the global exchange traded funds industry. Today's guests: Roundhill Investments Chief Investment Strategist Drew Pettit, Proshares Executive Director Tactical Products Inkoo Kang, and Baird Strategas Chief Strategist Todd Sohn. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: DeFi Development extends Solana buying streak to 11 straight weeks, SOL treasury hits 2.62 million
top_signals.summary: DeFi Development added about 5,180 SOL, lifting its Solana treasury to 2.62 million SOL in its 11th straight week of buying since Sept. 14.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
